style: Refine every catalog object toward warm, softly lit cartoon art, consistent with the selected plant reference. Preserve identity, function and original palette family. Keep registered camera, dimensions, roots, sockets, ports, footprints and animation timing. No preferred horizontal light direction for rotatable world sprites; no directional ground shadows. Real 3D render output, editable Blender sources. The source 2D effects remain explicitly identified as 2D. Each object receives fresh independent editor/judge agents. Publish object-by-object to the same PR preview; integrate approved sprites into Godot after catalog review checks. Follow-on design exploration: improve the modeling itself, including forms, proportions, structure, crafted details and decorations. Original part counts and awkward geometry are not constraints. The editor may rebuild native geometry to achieve the better design; the judge should reward useful improvements. Preserve the locked registration, gameplay contact/clearance, animation and modular continuity contract. See modeling-policy.json version2.

qualityCriteria.definitionOfGood: A substantial softly finished blue wreck terminal with distinct iron and pale fasteners, controlled colored plane highlights, coherent useful negative space and clean trueW connection in every facing/use size.

priorityOutcomes.desired: A substantial blue wreck frame with believable rail thickness, readable iron ribs and a purposeful finished terminal. Improve simple original geometry into crafted volumes within the root-frozen own functional budget. Four facings explain one coherent object; useful open bays remain readable.
priorityOutcomes.notRequired: Literal target board count, opacity over legitimate bays, old mesh count, particular bevel/shader implementation or source weak silhouette.

priorityOutcomes.desired: Rich blue/cyan hull paint, slate iron structure and pale fasteners remain distinct at128 and recognizable at32. Large color planes carry the structure; crafted seams, wear and fastening detail support rather than replace it.
priorityOutcomes.notRequired: ImageGen edge noise, halos, painted cracks or high-frequency grain at the cost of clarity.

priorityOutcomes.desired: Broad controlled soft highlights explain rounded and flat planes, with restrained warm accents and readable colored recesses. No black dead spot, harsh stripe, blown edge or preferred horizontal light direction. Exact canonical rig applies across all4.
priorityOutcomes.notRequired: Literal golden highlight placement from the single target view, per-view recoloring or camera fitting.
